name: memolily
source:
Summer vacation after the second year of junior high school. Yuta met a girl at a shrine. The girl had no name and was scared of people... Yuta named her "Lily" and worked for Lily with the advice of his grandmother.

Lily's heart opened and the time she was with him turned into a lovely one. 

"I want to stay with you like this..."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24144]Freem![/url]]
translation:
初二后的暑假。裕太在神社遇见了一位女孩。这个女孩没有名字，而且很怕人……裕太给她取名“莉莉”，并在祖母的建议下为莉莉工作。

莉莉的心敞开了，和他在一起的时光变得美好。

“我想就这样留在你身边……”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24144]Freem![/url]]
